Public Function Go(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, s As String, state As Long, wide As Double, high As Double, across As Double
    Dim down As Double, formulas As Boolean, status As Boolean
    Application.Visible = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    state = Application.WindowState
    Application.WindowState = xlNormal
    wide = Application.Width: high = Application.Height
    across = Application.Left: down = Application.Top
    formulas = Application.DisplayFormulaBar: status = Application.DisplayStatusBar
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    wb.Activate
    s = "dpi=" & wb.Worksheets(1).StandardHeight
    Application.Width = 800: Application.Height = 600: Application.Left = 20: Application.Top = 20
    wb.Windows(1).WindowState = xlNormal
    wb.Windows(1).Left = 0: wb.Windows(1).Top = 0: wb.Windows(1).Width = 700: wb.Windows(1).Height = 500
    On Error Resume Next
    Select Case which
    Case 0: s = s & Case0(wb.Windows(1))

    s = s & " dpi=" & wb.Worksheets(1).StandardHeight
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayFormulaBar = formulas
    Application.DisplayStatusBar = status
    Application.WindowState = xlNormal
    Application.Width = wide: Application.Height = high
    Application.Left = across: Application.Top = down
    Application.WindowState = state
    Go = s
End Function
